mapper.insert: INSERT INTO GROUP_CHAT_ROOM (ROOM_NAME, HOST_ID, MAX_MEMBER, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{roomName}, #{hostId}, #{maxMember}, NOW())
INSERT INTO GROUP_CHAT_MEMBER (ROOM_ID, USER_ID, ROLE, JOINED_AT) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{userId}, #{role}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GROUP_CHAT_MEMBER WHERE ROOM_ID = #{roomId}

SELECT R.ROOM_ID AS roomId, R.ROOM_NAME AS roomName, R.HOST_ID AS hostId, R.MAX_MEMBER AS maxMember, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GROUP_CHAT_MEMBER M2 WHERE M2.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID) AS memberCount, (SELECT CONTENT FROM GROUP_CHAT_MESSAGE MS WHERE MS.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID ORDER BY MS.CREATED_AT DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastMessage, (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') FROM GROUP_CHAT_MESSAGE MS WHERE MS.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID ORDER BY MS.CREATED_AT DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastMessageAt FROM GROUP_CHAT_ROOM R JOIN GROUP_CHAT_MEMBER M ON R.ROOM_ID = M.ROOM_ID WHERE M.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY lastMessageAt DESC

SELECT M.USER_ID AS userId, M.ROLE AS role, M.JOINED_AT AS joinedAt, U.USER_NAME AS userName, U.NICKNAME AS nickname, U.PROFILE_IMG_URL AS profileImg FROM GROUP_CHAT_MEMBER M JOIN USER U ON M.USER_ID = U.USER_ID WHERE M.ROOM_ID = #{roomId} ORDER BY M.ROLE ASC, M.JOINED_AT ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GROUP_CHAT_MEMBER WHERE ROOM_ID = #{roomId} AND USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM GROUP_CHAT_MEMBER WHERE ROOM_ID = #{roomId} AND USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO GROUP_CHAT_MESSAGE (ROOM_ID, USER_ID, MESSAGE_TYPE, CONTENT, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{userId}, #{messageType}, #{content}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT MS.MESSAGE_ID AS MESSAGE_ID, MS.ROOM_ID AS ROOM_ID, MS.USER_ID AS SENDER_ID, MS.MESSAGE_TYPE AS MESSAGE_TYPE, MS.CONTENT AS CONTENT, DATE_FORMAT(MS.CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATED_AT, U.NICKNAME AS SENDER_NICK, U.PROFILE_IMG_URL AS SENDER_IMG FROM GROUP_CHAT_MESSAGE MS JOIN USER U ON MS.USER_ID = U.USER_ID WHERE MS.ROOM_ID = #{roomId} ORDER BY MS.CREATED_AT ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE GROUP_CHAT_MEMBER SET ROLE = #{role} WHERE ROOM_ID = #{roomId} AND USER_ID = #{userId}
